messages.author: a46bda82d3a10fa0
messages.subject: Reference for RHadoop
parts:
Hi, 

We are thinking to write an article based on our latest work in the field of computational genetics. This time we have used RHadoop for structuring the computational environment. 

My source of information related to RHadoop  is through your GitHUB or this google forum. I am wondering how should I give the reference of RHadoop in my article? 

Can you please point to your article that I can cite or anyother useful link?

Thanks.

Regards..
Salman.

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1437] Reference for RHadoop
parts:
Hi Salman, 
you can point to https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki
We don't have an article about it. It would take a bit of imagination to see it as scholarly work. Please provide a link to your article if and when it becomes available.


Antonio
